hints.title: Choose a palindromic prefix
hints.body: Every split begins with some prefix of the remaining text. That prefix is allowed only when it reads the same forward and backward.

hints.title: Recurse on the rest
hints.body: After choosing a palindromic prefix, solve the same problem for the remaining suffix. When no characters remain, the current list of pieces is one complete split.

hints.title: Backtrack and sort
hints.body: Push the chosen piece, recurse, then pop it. The pieces stay in original order automatically. Sort the completed list of splits at the end to get the required lexicographic order.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
result = []
path = []

explore(start):
    if start == s.length:
        result.push(copy of path)
        return
    for end from start to s.length - 1:
        piece = s[start .. end]
        if piece is a palindrome:
            path.push(piece)
            explore(end + 1)
            path.pop()

explore(0)
sort result
return result
```
